entities.name: Establish bounded structured-concurrency laws
entities.summary: Compare a pure finite task/scope oracle with a scoped Effect v4 realization under explicit one-shot dispatch, cancellation delivery, ownership transfer, join, and exit semantics.

acceptance: Every live task has exactly one open owning scope unless explicitly transferred
Every dispatch is explicit and consumes exactly one finite task step
Cancellation request is idempotent and distinct from cancellation delivery
Join observes blocked progress or one stable terminal outcome
Scope exit requests cancellation and waits for owned live tasks and open child scopes
Pure and Effect v4 observations compare exactly without claiming production or kernel equivalence

relations.summary: The tracer discharges the bounded userland-law-model obligation selected by the algebra promotion frontier.
The comparison constrains later task executors without selecting production scheduler or kernel machinery.
